sources_considered.why: Google's primary announcement (Mar 14, 2025) that Assistant users on mobile are being moved to Gemini and that classic Assistant will be retired on most phones.
Google's primary I/O post (May 20, 2025), one day before the post, on AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search.
Dated news report that there is no option to disable AI Overviews and that a Web filter exists. It is from May 2024, before the target period, so it is used as context.
Google help page saying AI Overviews 'cannot be turned off' and pointing to the Web filter. It has no visible date and was read after the evaluation date, so it is not cited as an item.
Confirms the Google blog announcement; the primary source is cited instead.

evidence_items.locator: section 'What’s next for Google Assistant', paragraph 2

receipt.public_excerpt: Over the coming months, we’re upgrading more users on mobile devices from Google Assistant to Gemini; and later this year, the classic Google Assistant will no longer be accessible on most mobile devices

evidence_items.explanation: Google said it was replacing Assistant with its generative AI, Gemini, and would make classic Assistant inaccessible on most phones. This supports the claim that generative AI was being attached to Assistant with no lasting opt-out.

evidence_items.locator: section 'AI Mode in Search, for cutting-edge AI capabilities', paragraph 3

receipt.public_excerpt: As we get feedback, we'll graduate many features and capabilities from AI Mode right into the core Search experience. Starting this week, we're bringing a custom version of Gemini 2.5, our most intelligent model, into Search for both AI Mode and AI Overviews in the U.S.

evidence_items.explanation: One day before the post, Google said generative AI (Gemini 2.5) powers AI Overviews in Search and that AI features would move into the core Search experience. This supports 'stapled onto Google Search'.

receipt.public_excerpt: As of May 20, 2024, there is no built-in option to disable Google AI Overviews within search settings.

evidence_items.explanation: When AI Overviews rolled out, there was no setting to turn them off. This predates the target period, so it is context for the 'no choice' part, not decisive.

receipt.public_excerpt: a recently introduced "Web" filter might be a helpful alternative for users who prefer traditional search results.

evidence_items.explanation: Google offered a per-search 'Web' filter without AI Overviews. This gives users a limited choice and slightly softens 'you don't have a choice', though it is not a setting that turns the feature off.

unresolved_gaps: I found no dated Google statement from March to May 2025 that AI Overviews cannot be turned off. The no-off-switch evidence comes from 2024 reporting and an undated current help page.
In May 2025 the Assistant-to-Gemini switch was still rolling out, and many phones still had classic Assistant.
